segments.text: Imagine your car breaks down today. How do you cover this essential repair right now?
segments.visual_intent: reveal CAR REPAIR and question overlay on a still illustration of a broken vehicle.

segments.text: Name this specific repair cost now to address it directly. Locate your reserve money immediately for that need.
segments.visual_intent: identify CAR REPAIR object in close-up view and show READY RESERVE icon nearby.

segments.text: Check how you access these funds today. Review the actual conditions needed before any withdrawal.
segments.visual_intent: show READY RESERVE with three unchecked question marks representing access procedures and conditions.

segments.text: Label this emergency reserve separately from your future goal. This keeps their distinct purposes clear always.
segments.visual_intent: compare READY RESERVE readiness with FUTURE GOAL without showing transfer language or access steps.

segments.text: Review how these roles separate when personal circumstances change over time. Unexpected events may alter your needs.
segments.visual_intent: review separation of the two financial objects in a wide shot showing distinct states.

segments.text: Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose with clear emergency readiness today.
segments.visual_intent: hold brand logo and CTA text over a stable background without new raster generation.
